schema.name: ncaa-wrestling-bracket
schema.read_me_first: model.bracket_model says which rebuild procedure in SPEC.md applies to this file.

model.description: Single-elimination championship bracket. 2nd and 3rd are decided afterwards by Bergman wrestle-backs: only wrestlers who lost to the champion may wrestle for 2nd (earliest loser first, rounds WB2_*), the survivor meets the finals loser in the "2nd" bout; then the loser of that bout meets anyone who lost to the 2nd-place winner for 3rd (rounds WB3_*, "3rd"). A place can be awarded with no bout (method "automatic"). There is no drawn consolation sheet.

rounds.2nd: Bergman 2nd-place bout (wrestle-back survivor vs finals loser); winner is 2nd
rounds.Final: championship final (winner 1st, loser 2nd in all drawn-consolation models)
rounds.R32: championship first round of a 32-line draw
rounds.WB2_SF: Bergman wrestle-back for 2nd, last stage before the 2nd-place bout

result_types.Unknown: the source prints no result for this bout

result_type_suffix.-OT: overtime of any kind: OT, sudden victory (SV), tiebreaker (TB) or criteria (Cr) - see result_raw

from.line:N: came from draw line N (possibly advancing on byes, which are not rows)

team_scores.scope: Top ten as printed on the summary page (more than ten rows when teams tie)
